qualification_notes.u0002-s003: Application in an individual case must manifestly conflict with the Constitution; not a general judicial power to repeal legislation.
qualification_notes.u0044-s003: Limited to enumerated serious crimes; source ordinary assault example is too broad. Statute also permits warning the threatened person; card does not demand police reporting exclusively.
qualification_notes.u0044-s004: Tests the statutory close-relative exception to this particular offence, not an exemption from every professional reporting obligation.
qualification_notes.u0060-s001: Retains statutory elements rather than treating every unwelcome interaction as criminal.
qualification_notes.u0064-s001: General protective age only; expressly preserves statutory close-age exception. Does not assert that all acts involving an under-16-year-old are invariably criminal.
qualification_notes.u0064-s004: Qualified exploitation question, not an absolute prohibition on every relationship involving a 16–17-year-old.
qualification_notes.u0066-s003: Adult eligibility regardless of gender; avoids ambiguous wording of exact service age boundary.
qualification_notes.u0095-s005: Binding compensation agreement, not automatic termination of prosecution or directly enforceable criminal sentence.
qualification_notes.u0114-s003: Tests ordinary standalone fine only; does not repeat source assertion that all other penalties are registered.
qualification_notes.u0116-s003: Police guidance confirms consent of suspect and any complainant for fine procedure.
qualification_notes.u0123-s001: Provider confirms immigration/asylum legal services; no claim that all representation is free.

coverage_note: Coverage concerns the selected learning point, not every incidental detail in a sentence. Supporting IDs supply context and consolidated claims. Existing rows are reused unchanged.
